statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across five representative paths. Not covered: authenticated profile/upload/history, destructive account actions, actual signup submission, and media playback, because they require credentials, mutate external state, or expose substantially similar templates.

page.notes: Public adult-media catalog. Representative home, listing, detail, signup, and 404 templates audited.

Network totals, third parties and offenders
Homepage metadata, links and semantics probe

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark and default screenshots are pixel-equivalent in palette; the page is permanently dark and the DOM contains no preference-driven theme adaptation.
checkOutcomes.method: Compared default and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots and inspected CSS.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() returned zero active animations; only brief hover transitions are present.
checkOutcomes.method: Emulated reduced motion and queried document animations.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found one WCAG contrast failure; the dark-theme screenshot also shows muted grey metadata on near-black surfaces.
checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit plus visual review.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The platform supports startViewTransition, but route and state links use ordinary full-page navigation with no authored view-transition evidence.
checkOutcomes.method: Inspected navigation DOM/CSS and platform feature availability.

checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, scrollytelling, entry reveal, or other scroll-linked motion was present on the representative pages.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, entry reveal, or other scroll-linked motion was present on the representative pages.
The content carousels expose arrows and use ordinary scrolling; no pointermove-driven gesture system that fights native scrolling was observed.
On the 26,985px home page, navigation chrome remains static and there is no progress or scroll-state affordance.
checkOutcomes.method: Long mobile layout metrics plus screenshot/CSS inspection.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dropdown/navigation overlays are custom menu markup, while DOM/CSS inspection found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try fallback usage.
Navigation changes are abrupt and do not preserve or animate attention between dense listing and detail surfaces.
checkOutcomes.method: Walked listing-to-detail navigation and reviewed screenshots.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The required adult-content notice is a narrow, dismissible banner and does not cover the primary content.
checkOutcomes.method: First-load desktop and mobile screenshot review.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The adult notice and custom menus are implemented without dialog, popover, or details; recon found 0 dialog, 0 popover, and 0 details elements.
Two navigation rows, a tag rail, age banner, affiliate CTAs, and ad units consume substantial space and compete with the media catalog.
checkOutcomes.method: Visual review of home and detail first viewports.

checkOutcomes.evidence: At a 360px visual viewport, home overflow was 28px and the detail template expanded to 780px, producing 420px horizontal overflow.
checkOutcomes.method: Layout primitive at 360x800 on home and detail.

checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS/DOM inspection found viewport media queries but no container-type or @container adaptation for reused media cards and ad widgets.
checkOutcomes.method: Computed feature probe and CSS inspection.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The focused first link computed to outline-style none, and Lighthouse identified 46 target-size failures.
checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus probe and Lighthouse target-size audit.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage immediately presents dated and trending videos with clearly labelled browse/search navigation.
A representative browse journey reached the recent listing and a celebrity detail page without registration or a dead end.
The synthetic missing URL showed a prominent PAGE CANNOT BE FOUND explanation and Contact Us recovery link while preserving navigation.
Lighthouse measured LCP 4.5s, outside the good <=2.5s range; FCP was 2.1s and CLS 0.001.
Layout observers measured CLS 0.0048 on home and 0.00003 on detail, both comfortably good.
Trace and layout evidence recorded zero long tasks and 0ms total blocking time during initial load.
Home loaded 98 requests/2.15MB; the HAR identifies multiple parser-inserted candidates and a 1.05MB third-party MP4, while LCP reached 4.5s.
checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against page DOM plus Lighthouse/trace.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The page ships 12 scripts/526KB including jQuery, jQuery UI, Firebase modules, two ad providers, analytics, and site JS for a server-rendered catalog.
checkOutcomes.method: HAR script inventory and Lighthouse payload review.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The image primitive found 32 images without alt text and search inputs have no associated label or aria-label.
checkOutcomes.method: Image audit and rendered form-control inspection.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found a colour-contrast failure on the rendered dark interface.
The first keyboard-focused link had outline-style none; Lighthouse also found one heading-order failure.
checkOutcomes.method: Focus probe and Lighthouse structural audit.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary headings and card labels are readable in desktop/mobile screenshots, with consistent type and no observed text clipping in the first viewports.
checkOutcomes.method: Visual review at desktop and mobile sizes.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The detail page needs 780 CSS px at a 360px viewport, and Lighthouse found 46 undersized touch targets.
checkOutcomes.method: Narrow viewport layout plus Lighthouse target-size audit.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse captured a 401 network console error from /app/auth/check-session during load.
Doctype and charset pass, but 74/100 images lack dimensions and Lighthouse flags 21 image aspect-ratio problems.
checkOutcomes.method: Image primitive and Lighthouse best-practices audit.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found no deprecated APIs; no permission prompt appeared on load and ordinary form paste behavior was not obstructed.
Home, listing, signup, and detail pages expose descriptive titles; home/listing/detail expose specific meta descriptions.
Lighthouse SEO scored 1.0; viewport meta is present, links have real hrefs, and robots.txt allows crawling.
checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, DOM link probe, and robots fetch.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The public homepage declares canonical https://www.aznude.com/indexhiddenfrompublic.html instead of its visible URL; robots and sitemap otherwise return 200.
checkOutcomes.method: DOM canonical probe plus robots/sitemap fetch.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The celebrity detail page has no JSON-LD, while homepage recon found no Open Graph tags; rich entities lack complete share/structured metadata.
checkOutcomes.method: DOM queries on home and representative celebrity detail.

checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP and HSTS are absent; all four cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
The page contacted 16 third-party origins; 93/98 HAR requests and 2.05MB/2.15MB were classified third-party, including Google/DoubleClick and ad networks.
Signup exposes password and social login only; no passkey/WebAuthn capability was found. No permission prompt appeared on load.
CSP/frame-ancestors, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.
Raw HTML contains 97% of rendered content words and preserves title, H1, and description without JavaScript.
Representative listing, detail, signup and recovery pages rendered meaningful server content; no blank shell or cut-off modal was observed.

checkOutcomes.reason: This is a public media catalog rather than an installed app; offline playback/search is not a reasonable core expectation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This is a public media catalog rather than an installed app; offline playback/search is not a reasonable core expectation.
A missing route presents an explicit error, explanation, contact recovery and normal navigation rather than a blank shell.
html lang=en is correct, but no dir is declared and the captured CSS relies extensively on physical left/right positioning and margins.
The visible long-form date is appropriate for the declared English locale and no currencies or locale-sensitive numeric input were present.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative public pages do not display scheduled times, events, time zones, or DST-sensitive data.

Of 100 images, 55 use legacy formats, 34 lack srcset, 74 lack intrinsic dimensions, and two are oversized.

checkOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing transaction or productivity capability is expected for this public browse-only catalog; crawler-readable content is already server-rendered.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No agent-facing transaction or productivity capability is expected for this public browse-only catalog; crawler-readable content is already server-rendered.

checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation, generation, or other inference task is part of the representative catalog journey.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation, or other inference task is part of the representative catalog journey.
After ten full-page scroll cycles, heap grew from 17,532,655 to 17,914,914 bytes (2.2%) and node count from 255,121 to 258,072 (1.2%), with no unbounded pattern demonstrated.
The server-rendered media feed used a 17.5MB V8 heap; this is proportionate to a 100-image, ad-enabled catalog page despite a large native-node population.
Neither heap summary reports Detached* among top constructors; constructor populations remain broadly stable after repeated scrolling.
checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap constructor summaries before/after interaction.

principleOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing transaction or productivity capability is expected for this public browse-only catalog; crawler-readable content is already server-rendered. No summarisation, generation, or other inference task is part of the representative catalog journey.

paths.description: Homepage and global shell; covers discovery, search entry, current/trending feed, preferences, performance, privacy and global metadata.
Recent videos listing; representative of browse/category result templates and the route into detail content.
Celebrity detail; representative media/entity template and highest-risk mobile reflow surface.
Account creation form; representative primary form, authentication, autofill and validation surface.
Synthetic missing route; representative HTTP/error recovery state.

findings.summary: Mobile templates overflow horizontally
findings.evidence: At a 360px visual viewport, home overflow was 28px and the detail template expanded to 780px, producing 420px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed/min widths and use intrinsic fluid sizing so every template reflows at 360px.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is suppressed and many touch targets are undersized
findings.evidence: The focused first link computed to outline-style none, and Lighthouse identified 46 target-size failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a strong :focus-visible ring and size interactive targets to at least 24px, preferably 44px.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow at 4.5 seconds
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.5s, outside the good <=2.5s range; FCP was 2.1s and CLS 0.001.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset and defer non-critical ad/media work until after primary content.

findings.summary: Search controls and many images lack accessible alternatives
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 32 images without alt text and search inputs have no associated label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate visible labels with search controls and provide appropriate alt or empty alt text.

findings.summary: Zoom/reflow and touch-target usability fail on core templates
findings.evidence: The detail page needs 780 CSS px at a 360px viewport, and Lighthouse found 46 undersized touch targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Make detail media intrinsically responsive and increase target spacing/sizing.

findings.summary: Homepage canonical points to indexhiddenfrompublic.html
findings.evidence: The public homepage declares canonical https://www.aznude.com/indexhiddenfrompublic.html instead of its visible URL; robots and sitemap otherwise return 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the homepage canonical to https://www.aznude.com/ and verify sitemap/indexing consistency.

findings.summary: Security headers are absent and cookies are not Secure
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP and HSTS are absent; all four cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP and HSTS, and set Secure with an appropriate SameSite policy on every cookie.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party collection dominate the page load
findings.evidence: The page contacted 16 third-party origins; 93/98 HAR requests and 2.05MB/2.15MB were classified third-party, including Google/DoubleClick and ad networks.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential tracking behind informed consent, and batch analytics.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are missing
findings.evidence: CSP/frame-ancestors, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and a restrictive Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Advertising can be mistaken for catalog content
findings.evidence: Affiliate/ad content is inserted among catalog content with sexually explicit headlines and weak or absent ad labelling, making destination type easy to mistake.
findings.suggestedFix: Label every ad/affiliate unit prominently and visually separate it from editorial results.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and media exceed a proportionate budget
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 93 requests and 2.05MB, including ad/analytics scripts and an automatically fetched 1.05MB MP4.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce per-template third-party/media budgets; lazy-load non-essential vendors.

findings.summary: Fixed dark palette ignores the user colour-scheme preference
findings.evidence: Dark and default screenshots are pixel-equivalent in palette; the page is permanently dark and the DOM contains no preference-driven theme adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement preference-driven light/dark tokens with color-scheme and prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Muted text does not consistently meet minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found one WCAG contrast failure; the dark-theme screenshot also shows muted grey metadata on near-black surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise muted text/UI contrast to WCAG AA in every theme.

findings.summary: Dismissible UI is built without semantic top-layer primitives
findings.evidence: The adult notice and custom menus are implemented without dialog, popover, or details; recon found 0 dialog, 0 popover, and 0 details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace custom notices/menus with dialog, popover or details as appropriate.

findings.summary: Navigation, tags, banners and promotions compete with core content
findings.evidence: Two navigation rows, a tag rail, age banner, affiliate CTAs, and ad units consume substantial space and compete with the media catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary chrome and clearly separate optional promotions from catalog content.

findings.summary: Resource delivery delays primary content
findings.evidence: Home loaded 98 requests/2.15MB; the HAR identifies multiple parser-inserted candidates and a 1.05MB third-party MP4, while LCP reached 4.5s.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, defer scripts, cache static assets, and avoid preloading third-party media.

findings.summary: The initial page ships a broad legacy and third-party script stack
findings.evidence: The page ships 12 scripts/526KB including jQuery, jQuery UI, Firebase modules, two ad providers, analytics, and site JS for a server-rendered catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit coverage, remove unused jQuery/UI/Firebase code, and conditionally load ads/analytics.

findings.summary: Images lack dimensions and often render at incorrect aspect ratios
findings.evidence: Doctype and charset pass, but 74/100 images lack dimensions and Lighthouse flags 21 image aspect-ratio problems.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio from media metadata and preserve intrinsic proportions.

findings.summary: Rich pages lack complete structured and social metadata
findings.evidence: The celebrity detail page has no JSON-LD, while homepage recon found no Open Graph tags; rich entities lack complete share/structured metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate entity JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata to detail templates.

findings.summary: Account creation offers no phishing-resistant passkey path
findings.evidence: Signup exposes password and social login only; no passkey/WebAuthn capability was found. No permission prompt appeared on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add WebAuthn/passkey registration and sign-in alongside existing methods.

findings.summary: Physical CSS properties make bidirectional layout brittle
findings.evidence: html lang=en is correct, but no dir is declared and the captured CSS relies extensively on physical left/right positioning and margins.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare direction and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Signup requirements are not encoded or announced
findings.evidence: Signup email/password fields are not marked required in the DOM, so requirements and validation state are not conveyed before submission.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark required fields, validate after interaction, and announce errors with aria-describedby/live regions.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not responsive or format-efficient
findings.evidence: Of 100 images, 55 use legacy formats, 34 lack srcset, 74 lack intrinsic dimensions, and two are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP srcsets with intrinsic dimensions and sizes matched to card breakpoints.

findings.summary: Initial load fetches media before user intent
findings.evidence: Initial load makes 98 requests, including 22 XHR/fetch requests and a 1.05MB third-party MP4 before an explicit media choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer third-party video and background fetches until visible or explicitly requested.

findings.summary: Dense navigation changes provide no continuity or attention cue
findings.evidence: The platform supports startViewTransition, but route and state links use ordinary full-page navigation with no authored view-transition evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Add reduced-motion-aware same/cross-document View Transitions for browse-to-detail changes.

findings.summary: Very long feeds provide no scroll-state orientation
findings.evidence: On the 26,985px home page, navigation chrome remains static and there is no progress or scroll-state affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use sticky scroll-state-aware chrome or a lightweight progress/position affordance.

findings.summary: Custom menus do not use resilient anchored positioning
findings.evidence: Dropdown/navigation overlays are custom menu markup, while DOM/CSS inspection found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try fallback usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: Reusable components only respond to the viewport
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM inspection found viewport media queries but no container-type or @container adaptation for reused media cards and ad widgets.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type and @container rules to cards/widgets reused at different widths.

findings.summary: Initial load emits a 401 console/network error
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a 401 network console error from /app/auth/check-session during load.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid the unauthenticated session request or handle its expected response without a console error.
